summary: Synapse acts as a home server for the Matrix ecosystem, implementing an open standard for decentralized and persistent communication. It handles the relaying of messages, user authentication, and synchronisation across multiple clients in a federated network. By hosting this software, you can run your own independent communication node that interoperates with other servers on the network.
goodFor: Self-hosters and organisations wanting to establish a private, federated messaging infrastructure under their own administrative control.
watchOut: Resource consumption can be relatively high under load, and managing a federated server requires careful handling of database maintenance and storage growth.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged via debian formats, it typically requires a separate PostgreSQL database for optimal performance and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
